text: Seeds 70-72 give raw accel_step R2 of ~0.91 at e<=0.5, ~0.87 at 0.6, ~0.80 at 0.7 and ~0.56 at 0.85, with 0.75 and 0.8 pending. Does the fraction of validation snapshots with r/a below some cutoff (e.g. r/a < 0.3, which only appears at higher e) predict raw R2 across these ceilings better than the e ceiling itself? That would show whether the loss of decodability is a pericentre-tail effect.
